Specialist by Nietzsche, Hegel, Herder, Kant, Descartes, D'Alembert..., has evolved into the study of great modern movements and its influence on contemporary Postmodernism. entities.summary: Gonçal Mayos Solsona is a Spanish philosopher, essayist and professor at the University of Barcelona.
